items.exampleEn: She is a very nice person.
The girl in the red dress is my sister.
items.exampleZh: 穿紅色洋裝的女孩是我的姊妹。

items.exampleEn: That boy is ten years old.
My son is the same age as your son.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子和你兒子同年紀。

items.sentenceEn: Who is that person at the door?

items.audioEn: Leo is a nice guy. He has a job at a bank.
items.audioZh: Leo 人很好，他在銀行上班。

items.sentenceEn: That guy is the same age as me.
The boy and the girl are good friends.
items.sentenceZh: 那個男孩和那個女孩是好朋友。

items.stemEn: I am a nurse at a hospital. It is a good ____.
items.stemZh: 我在醫院當護士，這是一份好工作。

items.passageEn: Hi! My name is Mia. I am a nurse, and I like my job. I live with my husband and our two kids, a boy and a girl. The boy is eight, and the girl is five. They are very good kids.
items.passageZh: 嗨！我的名字是 Mia。我是護士，我喜歡我的工作。我和我先生還有兩個小孩住在一起，一個男孩和一個女孩。男孩八歲，女孩五歲。他們都是很乖的孩子。

items.promptZh: 他在一家銀行有一份工作。
referenceEn: He has a job at a bank.
He has a job in a bank.
rubricZh: 「有一份工作」可寫，例如 has a job 等；寫 works at a bank 也正確
「在銀行」可寫，例如 at a bank、in a bank 等

items.promptZh: 這個年紀的孩子很喜歡玩。
referenceEn: Kids at this age love to play.
Children at this age love to play.
rubricZh: 「這個年紀」可寫，例如 at this age 等
「很喜歡玩」可寫，例如 love to play、love playing、like playing a lot 等
